title: FloodGuard Midterm Limit Increase: Additional Premium Charge
content:
A limit increase recorded midterm on a FloodGuard Private Flood Policy with additional premium due is charged to the policy's premium account as an additional premium. The limit-increase entry on the policy records the new limit, the date the increase attaches, the date it was requested and the full-year premium change of the increase; the additional premium is the amount this policy fixes for that increase.

## Business effect of the charge

Charging a limit increase posts one additional-premium charge for the named limit increase to the policy's premium account, dated the day it is charged and marked as a coverage increase attaching on the date given. The premium account then shows that additional-premium charge and a higher amount owed. Each charge belongs to one limit-increase entry, which it names.

## The charging tool

The charge is posted with the agent-side tool `bill_flood_increase_premium_f099355d`. The agent unlocks the tool and then calls it.

### Parameters

- `flood_policy_id` — the reference number of the FloodGuard flood policy record charged, as returned by the flood policy lookup for the verified caller.
- `flood_endorsement_id` — the reference number of the limit-increase entry the charge belongs to, as returned by the flood endorsement lookup.
- `attach_date` — the date the limit increase attaches, written as YYYY-MM-DD.
- `amount` — the additional premium charged, in USD as a plain number with 2 decimal places; stored rounded half-up to 2 decimal places.

| Parameter | Kind | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `flood_policy_id` | reference number | as returned by the flood policy lookup |
| `flood_endorsement_id` | reference number | as returned by the flood endorsement lookup |
| `attach_date` | date | YYYY-MM-DD |
| `amount` | money | USD, 2 decimal places |

The tool takes no enumerated values.

### Receipt

A successful call returns `flood_billing_id` (the reference number of the new charge), `flood_endorsement_id` (the limit increase charged), `amount` (USD with 2 decimal places), `posted_date` (YYYY-MM-DD) and `status`. A status of `increase_premium_billed` means the charge posted.

*Illustration with hypothetical values:* a call naming a policy, its limit-increase entry, an attach date of 2025-05-15 and an amount of 212.40 returns a receipt carrying a new charge reference, that same entry reference, 212.40, the posting date and `increase_premium_billed`; the premium account then shows an additional-premium charge of 212.40 marked as a coverage increase attaching on 2025-05-15.
